headline: Public hearings on cemetery fee changes and three utility projects, including gas mains on Waugh, Bertha, and Wilder streets.
summary: Council motions ask for reports on senior center upgrades, department salaries, and North Common parking. A National Grid conduit for a new building at 681 Merrimack Street is also on the list.
items: Release of executive minutes from October 6, 2026 (Draper and Lowell Housing Authority)
Ordinance to amend the cemetery fee schedule
Boston Gas request to install about 1,515 feet of plastic gas main on Waugh, Bertha, and Wilder streets
Boston Gas request to install about 100 feet of replacement gas main between 304-330 W Sixth St
National Grid request to install conduit from MH141 to 681 Merrimack St for a new building
Motion to ask for a report on upgrading the senior center using employees, trade students, and volunteers
Motion to let NABET members give an update on LTC and employment conditions
Motion to begin year-end evaluations for the three positions that report to the Council
Motion to ask for a salary comparison report for department heads, assistant city managers, and other top positions
Motion to ask the state to open the North Common parking lot for the winter
City Manager response: LHA Merrimack Corridor project presentation
City Manager response: letter to state delegation on ICC
City Manager response: letter of support for Sergeant Major Dors Musgray
City Manager response: MassHire youth programming update
Informational report on traffic ordinance amendments
Appointment of new members to the Conservation Commission
Wire inspector reports: four from Boston Gas, two from National Grid, and one from Zayo Networks
Claims: one personal injury and one property damage
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA/Zoom (Hybrid)

CITY COUNCIL - MOTIONS
C. Robinson - Req. The City Mgr. Have The Proper Department Provide A Report On 
A Path Forward To Utilize Employees, Local Trade Students, And Volunteers To 
Upgrade Our Senior Center Facility While Remaining In Compliance With MA. 
Procurement Requirements.
C. Robinson - Req. The City Council Allow Members Of NABET Provide An Update 
On LTC And Current Employment Conditions.
C. Juran - Req. City Mgr. Have Human Relations Director Work With City Council To 
Begin Year-End Evaluation Process For The Three Positions That Report To The 
Council.
C. McDonough - Req. The City Mgr. Have The Appropriate Department Provide A 
Report Comparing Salaries For Department Head/Director Level Positions, Assistant 
City Managers, The City Clerk, City Auditor, And City Manager With Other Gateway 
Cities, Surrounding Communities, And The Other Two Plan E Cities Over The Last 5 
Years. 
M. Gitschier - Req. The City Mgr. Reach Out To The State And Open The North 
Common Parking Lot For The Winter.
